taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from Features of individual bones (Upper Limb).

words.clue: The only long bone that lies horizontally and connects the shoulder girdle to the axial skeleton
Flat triangular bone that serves as the mobile platform for all shoulder movements
The roof of the shoulder, formed by the lateral continuation of the scapular spine
The shallow oval articular socket that articulates with the humeral head to form the shoulder joint
Hook-like process on the anterior surface of the scapula at the superior angle
Rotator cuff muscle originating from the supraspinous fossa that initiates arm abduction
Lateral rotator muscle that originates from the infraspinous fossa of the scapula
Medial rotator of the arm that originates from the subscapular fossa on the costal surface
The boxer's muscle that protracts the scapula and can be paralyzed by long thoracic nerve injury
Muscle that elevates and retracts the shoulder, attaching to the lateral one-third of the clavicle
Bony ridge that divides the posterior surface of the scapula into two fossae
Groove on the inferior surface of the clavicle where the subclavius muscle lies
